nodes.label: MyCryptoStack Design System (MDS) v0.3
nodes.rationale: Governing principle: specify, do not enumerate — every rule is an enforceable contract with a value/threshold so designers, devs, tooling and CI derive the same behavior without interpretation. Foundations defined mathematically before components so nothing is refactored later.

nodes.label: Three-Tier Token Architecture (Primitive → Semantic → Component)
nodes.rationale: Components never reference raw colors; theming swaps only the semantic layer, which is what makes the four themes maintainable.

nodes.label: Perceptual OKLCH Color (Obsidian Indigo direction)
nodes.rationale: OKLCH not hex for even lightness steps and clean gradients; never pure #000/#fff — neutrals tinted toward brand hue; APCA-scored contrast pairs required per release.

nodes.label: Elevation Recipe (surface steps + 1px specular hairline, e0–e3)
nodes.rationale: Depth on dark comes from surface-lightness steps + specular top hairline, not heavy shadows; the specular is 'the single biggest flat-to-crafted move'. Max 3 levels above canvas.

nodes.label: Numeral Design Language (B5): tabular mono, decimal alignment, precision rules
nodes.rationale: Numbers are most of a trading UI so they get their own contract: Geist Mono tabular-nums, precision as max(exchange tick, magnitude), locale-aware (USD + INR lakh/crore), ≤250ms tick-flash on change.

nodes.label: Motion Grammar (ease-out only, 120–300ms, transform/opacity only)
nodes.rationale: No bounce/elastic; layout-affecting properties forbidden (lift via translateY, not top); every animation carries a prefers-reduced-motion fallback.

nodes.label: Component Platform (C): Panel, Num, DataTable and primitives with full contracts
nodes.rationale: Built only after Foundations (B) is frozen; every component documents the same contract (anatomy, tokens, states, a11y, keyboard, responsive, anti-patterns) and consumes component-tier tokens only.

nodes.label: C-FREEZE: Panel primitive frozen 2026-06-27
nodes.rationale: No new local panel/card/widget implementations in pages; new behavior extends the shared Panel via props and re-runs the Visual Regression Checklist rather than forking a variant. Enforced by eslint no-restricted-syntax in CI.

nodes.label: B5-FREEZE: Num component is the only legal financial-value renderer
nodes.rationale: Callers choose a SEMANTIC variant (Num.Price/Money/Pnl/Pct/Delta/RR/Qty/Score/Compact), never raw formatting; no toLocaleString/toFixed in pages — new value types add a variant in Num.tsx.

nodes.label: H-FREEZE: DataTable Column<T> API frozen at v1.0
nodes.rationale: Validated across all four table archetypes (Analytics, Comparison, Historical, Diagnostic) with no API change, so frozen. Fixed layering: DataTable → Column Presets → Financial Cells → Num.*; v2 features are additive, never a fork.

nodes.label: Financial Data Visualization Grammar (D): chart-type matrix, color budget, overlay z-order
nodes.rationale: Chart type chosen by intent, never novelty; ≤6 distinct hues per chart; fixed 7-layer overlay stacking order with crosshair/tooltip always on top.

nodes.label: Explainable AI Grammar (E): never a score without its reasons
nodes.rationale: The differentiator. 11 required AI-card slots (verdict, confidence, direction, evidence, counter-signals, risk, history, source, uncertainty, action, affordances); contradictory evidence surfaced, never hidden; empty slots render honest empty states, never fabricated values.

nodes.label: Market State Grammar (F): orthogonal perceptual channels per dimension
nodes.rationale: Direction, confidence, risk, volatility, liquidity and signal-agreement each own an independent visual channel; green must not mean both 'up' and 'confident'. Conflicting signals are a first-class state rendered side-by-side, never averaged into one number.

nodes.label: Dashboard Grammar & Cognitive Load Budget (G): viewport/color/motion/alert budgets + IHS ≥ 80
nodes.rationale: Measurable limits so dashboards stay usable as features are added; widget cap is a function of density mode (resolves the old 4-vs-8 contradiction); accent+semantic pixel coverage ≤10%, gold ≤2%.

nodes.label: Financial Tables Contract (H): alignment, sticky, sort, virtualization >100 rows
nodes.rationale: Numbers never truncate (reduce density or wrap the column instead); live-updated rows never reflow or jump — they animate position only when the active sort demands it.

nodes.label: State Transition Grammar (I): Loading→Ready→Live→Stale→Disconnected lifecycle
nodes.rationale: Never render stale data as if live; never blank the screen on disconnect (freeze last value and label it); AI/confidence cards downgrade when their inputs are stale.

nodes.label: Responsive Trading Layouts (J): panel is the responsive unit, ultrawide adds panels
nodes.rationale: Trading needs more than phone breakpoints — 7 environments up to multi-monitor floating windows; extra width adds workspace columns, never stretches one panel; line length ≤75ch.

nodes.label: Plugin & Extension Architecture (K): CustomIndicator, AIProvider, ExchangeConnector contracts
nodes.rationale: Extension points are versioned, capability-scoped, sandboxed contracts from day one; an AIProvider that cannot supply evidence + confidence is rejected; contracts bind to existing code (lib/indicatorFramework, golden-master harness, lib/dataSource registry).

nodes.label: Engineering Platform (L): frozen-contract lint, token lint, 250KB bundle budget, Storybook, axe
nodes.rationale: Transforms the design system from a document into an enforceable standard — freezes are enforced by lint in CI, not code review; single-source theming via one [data-theme] block per theme in app/globals.css.
